legacy_baseline_local_only.ordering_rule: Within each frozen reviewed profile set: descending raw legacy score, then source, display title, and internal opportunity ref.
legacy_baseline_local_only.candidate_rule: All reviewed opportunities are scored locally; only deterministic eligible/unknown survivors receive a semantic-survivor rank.

metrics.definition: Concordant covered cross-label pairs divided by all covered cross-label pairs; higher human class must rank first.
metrics.coverage_rule: A ranking-quality pair is covered only when both deterministic survivors have valid semantic packets and a validated semantic ordering in the same provider-blind request. Uncovered pairs are reported only as coverage.

metrics.definition: Count covered pairs the legacy survivor order places below the lower-relevance item and semantic order corrects.
Count covered pairs legacy orders correctly and semantic order reverses against the human classes.
Per-profile Kendall tau-b between rank and ordinal human grade, preserving human-class ties; report macro mean and pair-weighted mean.
Report NDCG@min(3,n), full-list NDCG, and top-1-max-class hit. Use ordinal grades strong=3, plausible=2, weak=1, false_positive=0 with gains 2^grade-1; compare semantic minus legacy.
metrics.profile_scope: Only profiles whose covered candidates include at least two human classes; same-class order never creates a win or loss.

metrics.definition: Report packet and valid-output coverage by judgment, opportunity, profile, and cross-label pair, plus blocker category.
metrics.missingness_treatment: Missing, unavailable, or invalid packets are not semantic ranking errors or wins and remain outside quality denominators.

quality_metrics.pair_coverage_condition: both judgments are deterministic survivors with valid packets and a validated semantic ordering from the same blinded request

forbidden_information: legacy rank, score, section, bucket, or tie break
semantic output from any previous benchmark
provider_blinding.opportunity_evidence_authority: validated native packet sourced only from accepted/LKG evidence

contamination_and_independence.semantic_architecture_fixture: tests/fixtures/semantic_matching_shadow_v1.json uses a synthetic profile and separate reviewed OE contract cases
contamination_and_independence.generic_architecture_regression_use: The closed semantic-shadow report read only aggregate foundation counts and proposed three profile IDs for an unexecuted future run; it did not load relevance labels into the semantic evaluator.
contamination_and_independence.legacy_baseline_prior_exposure: The current legacy matcher and fixture metadata have prior golden-set regression exposure. Results therefore compare against an in-sample, potentially advantaged legacy baseline and are not a generalization claim.
